name: dirty-pixels
description: Redraw any image as flowing pixel-particle art on black: strokes travel along the image's own structure, with physics-planned regional motion and seamless loops.

interface.shortDescription: Flowing pixel-particle redraws with seamless loops
interface.longDescription: A deterministic renderer that redraws an image as stroke particles on pure black. Strokes follow the image's own structure-tensor direction field and really travel along it; short specks carry the image while long frayed streaks carry the motion. Per-region motion is planned from the picture's physics (light falls, embers rise, barrels rotate), density conservation removes field-attractor artifacts, and every animation loops seamlessly. Outputs PNG, GIF and MP4.
defaultPrompt: Redraw this image as flowing pixel-particle art with a seamless loop.
Turn this picture into black-background particle strokes that move along its structure.
Make an animated dirty-pixels version of this image for a video cover.
